description: Create a new playlist. Videos are REFERENCES — removing from playlist does NOT delete the video. Returns the created {id, name, description, access_type}.

access_type.description: Access type — REQUIRED by the Panda API; defaults to anyone_with_link

creator_name.description: Creator name displayed in player — REQUIRED by the API; defaults to the playlist name

title: Create Playlist
